scope: All retained error metadata families and the guard constructor categories they exercise; test names are consumers, not claims that missing full-feature suites were executed.

guards.guard: StateEnvelope::require_native_execution always rejects codec-only execution; native coverage is established by NativeSession compilation
guards.retain_until: An explicitly versioned diagnostic migration; codec decoding alone never implies executable rules

guards.guard: Invalid physical references, future versions, unknown fields and stale revisions must reject without committed mutation
guards.retain_until: Permanent supported-boundary invariants; change only through an explicit version/migration decision

guards.classification: historical porting/representation limitation, not a new gameplay rule
guards.guard: Unsupported nested programs, unbound selectors and reached dense-path queries reject before consuming/mutating the root. Inert unsupported templates may be importable.
guards.retain_until: Port the exact consumer with full differential/restore regressions; never relax a guard merely because an import succeeds

guards.guard: Cancellation, deadlines, step limits and exhausted request/step/entity generations preserve real boundaries and reject fake progress
guards.retain_until: Retain limits and identity invariants through any implementation change

guards.classification: frozen Python reference defect with explicit native coverage guard
guards.retain_until: Separate reviewed reference/native semantics decision; do not silently normalize the RecursionError into an accepted gameplay result

guards.classification: frozen Python reference defects and documented order/coercion boundary
guards.native_policy: mine path identity is an unordered set with stable native order; explicit trigger/event order is preserved; literal-destination loss remains a documented source compatibility defect
guards.retain_until: Preserve explicit event/trigger order and the admitted source/native policy; any correction needs its own review
